mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 3 consecutive months indicates the Federal Reserve is shifting from tightening to easing, lowering discount rates and boosting equity valuations, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the federal funds rate above 5.25% signals a tightening cycle, raising discount rates and compressing equity valuations, which predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in unemployment benefits (PAYEMS) exceeding 1% month-over-month for three consecutive months reduces consumer purchasing power, which suppresses S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in rising benefits periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in unemployment benefits (PAYEMS) below the previous month by at least 1% signals a tightening labor market, increasing consumer confidence and boosting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in falling benefits periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 1% for three consecutive months indicates strengthening supply-side demand, which supports S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in rising production periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below the prior month by at least 1% for three consecutive months signals weakening demand, which predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in falling production periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in consumer inflation (CPIAUCSL) above 0.5% for three consecutive months indicates supply-side pressures, which compresses S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in rising inflation periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in consumer inflation (CPIAUCSL) below 0.2% for three consecutive months signals easing supply constraints, which supports S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in falling inflation periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
